metadata_caption: Exactly one year ago today, we drove Ophelia up 12,000 feet in elevation. Little did we know, this video would quite literally change our lives for the better. Remember, you are only one video away from your dream becoming a reality. We are extremely grateful to have you here with us and are excited for what the future holds! 🤗 #skoolielife #dream #lifeontheroad #travel #lifestyle #colorado
